success.description: You invoke the blessing and may immediately perform a free Guarded Position action

boon.description: Each enemy engaged with the affected trees suffers 1 stress and 1 fatigue as the boughs flail at them

conservative.requirements: 6 favour, targets trees and bushes within long range reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc} Effect: The trees and shrubs of this forest spring to life to defend you. While this blessing is recharging, you may perform a free Guarded Position action at the beginning of your turn. While you and your allies remain engaged with trees and shrubs within long range of you, you can all benefit from the Guarded Position action as the greenery protects you

success.description: You invoke the blessing and may immediately perform a free Melee Strike action

boon.description: Each enemy engaged with the affected trees suffers 1 stress and 1 fatigue as the boughs flail at them

bane.description: Each ally engaged with the affected trees suffers 1 stress

reckless.requirements: Special: If you have Nature Lore, reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc}. Effect: The trees and shrubs of this forest spring to life to attack your enemies. While this blessing is recharging, you may perform a free Melee Strike action at the beginning of your turn, targeting any enemy engaged with the affected trees and shrubs
